capabilities.name: AIX semantic message envelope
capabilities.description: A Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema defines the experimental AIX message envelope for intent, tasks, responses, capabilities, context, status, errors, security references, and provenance.
limitations: The envelope is an extension layer and does not replace MCP, A2A, HTTP, OpenAPI, or JSON-RPC.

capabilities.name: Task lifecycle vocabulary
capabilities.description: The specification defines a constrained task lifecycle and message semantics with positive and negative fixtures.
limitations: No distributed task scheduler, persistence layer, or runtime state machine is implemented.

capabilities.name: MCP and A2A mapping profiles
capabilities.description: Define concrete interoperable mappings between AIX messages and established agent protocols.
limitations: Mapping guidance is conceptual; executable MCP and A2A adapters are not implemented.

capabilities.name: Production runtime and SDK
capabilities.description: Provide maintained language SDKs and production runtime integration for AIX messages.
limitations: No production runtime, SDK, transport, or certification is included.

explicit_non_capabilities: Private model reasoning or chain-of-thought transport
